purpose: Bounded public recovery overlay for the 2026-09-21 portfolio-convergence state. It intentionally excludes applicant-private values and volatile per-application answers.

precedence: current GitHub policy/code/contracts and current checkpoint
authority.rule: Refresh current main, EventBus, Work_Leases, Agent_Inbox/global barriers and provider evidence before any mutation.

runtimegraph.rule: Do not use RuntimeGraph/Human_Now/Agent_Next as current authority until a full deterministic rebuild after canonical reconciliation.

prohibitions: blind resend after unknown provider outcome
ticket purchase before required written travel approval
historical frontier treated as current without live reconciliation
retirement_rule: Replace or expire after the next material provider/application/control-plane transition; never extend by editing the timestamp alone.
